name: Aircall
one_liner: Business phone system with a Public REST API, webhooks and AI-native developer platform.
auth_notes: Basic Auth uses an API ID and API token generated by an Aircall admin in the dashboard, sent Base64-encoded. OAuth 2.0 is for Technology Partner apps on the Aircall Marketplace.
access_notes: Basic Auth keys are self-generated in the dashboard by an Admin for your own account. Multi-customer OAuth requires Technology Partner signup and Marketplace listing, and client credentials come after a form and reply from Aircall. Cost is not stated on the fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Basic Auth keys are self-serve for one account, but multi-customer OAuth requires Technology Partner signup and Marketplace listing. Endpoint count and plan requirements are not stated on the fetched pages.

identity.quote: At Aircall, we are building the next-gen business phone system

auth.quote: With Aircall Public API, Authentication can be done through OAuth or Basic Auth.

access.quote: If you are an Aircall customer, building for your own Aircall account only, the Basic Auth flow will do the trick.
It is a requirement to be listed on the Aircall App Marketplace.

api_surface.quote: Aircall Public API is a classic REST API.

buildability.quote: It is a requirement to be listed on the Aircall App Marketplace.
